title: My Grandmother
text:
My grandmother was born in 1950 in a small village. She worked as a teacher for thirty years. She loved reading books and painting pictures. Many students remember her kindness.

In 1990 she moved to the city with my grandfather. They had three children. Now she lives near us and cooks for the whole family every Sunday.

questions.text: When did she move to the city?
How does the writer feel about the grandmother?
options: The writer is angry with her
The writer does not know her
The writer is bored by her

questions.text: What was the grandmother's job most likely?

vocabulary.definition: a small place in the countryside where people live
the quality of being friendly and caring towards others

paragraph_translations: Büyükannem 1950 yılında küçük bir köyde doğdu. Otuz yıl boyunca öğretmen olarak çalıştı. Kitap okumayı ve resim yapmayı çok severdi. Birçok öğrenci onun nezaketini hâlâ hatırlar.
1990 yılında büyükbabamla birlikte şehre taşındı. Üç çocukları oldu. Şimdi bize yakın yaşıyor ve her Pazar bütün aile için yemek pişiriyor.
